facts.fact: INSA is stated to be the national body under Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity Proclamation No. 1426/2026, which sets the foundation for cybersecurity monitoring and coordinated incident response; the document gives no proclamation date, so the publication date is used.

The proclamation identifies 12 critical infrastructure sectors (ICT, finance, transport, health, energy and others) and requires owners and operators to meet 18 cybersecurity obligations; the document gives no enactment date, so the publication date is used.
